unit.why: Mainly an ethical teaching against harsh and excessive speech, quoted from an older moralistic work (א״ה פ״ה), with a short embedded exemplum: a deceased pious man appears to his wife radiant with light.
unit.boundary_note: Teaching on speech continues from the previous division (heading 'מענין דיבור'); the embedded exemplum is self-contained.

stories.start_quote: ומצינו בחסיד א׳ כשמת ובא אח״כ
stories.summary_en: After a pious man died, he appeared to his wife shining like a torch and told her that he had merited this radiance because he had spoken very little in his life.

tags.why: The exemplum is wrapped in an ethical discourse about speech.

quotes: וזו הוא מדה טובה למעט בדבור בכל מה דאפשר
tags.why: The declared purpose is instruction in the virtue of restrained speech.

quotes: ומצינו בחסיד א׳ כשמת ובא אח״כ לאשתו
tags.why: It praises an anonymous pre-Hasidic pious man taken from an older book.

quotes: וראתה אותו מאיר מאד וכל שערות ראשו וזקנו מאירים כגד אבוקה
tags.why: His radiance signifies the merit of his righteousness.

quotes: והגיד לה שכ״ז זכה על שהיה כ״כ ממעט בדיבורו
tags.why: The dead man's soul speaks with his wife.

quotes: ובא אח״כ לאשתו וראתה אותו מאיר מאד
tags.why: The wife sees her dead husband; the text does not say whether this was a dream.
The pious man's death frames the apparition.

quotes: ובא אח״כ לאשתו וראתה אותו מאיר מאד
tags.why: The wife is the one who sees him and hears his message.
The exemplum illustrates the merit of minimal speech.

quotes: שיצטרך לסבול צער גדול בשביל דבור קל
tags.why: The surrounding frame describes the posthumous suffering that follows sinful speech.

missing_concepts: guarding one's speech (שמירת הלשון / מיעוט דיבור)
apparition of a dead person to the living
